details.effect: [evolve] [cost02]: Evolve this follower. [fanfare] Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put one of them into your EX area. Bury the rest. [act] [engage], discard a card: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 5 damage.

issues: Fanfare is encoded with filter {trait: "iM@S CG"}, but the source says you may put one of the top 3 cards into your EX area with no trait restriction. Change the effect to look at the top 3 cards, choose any 1 to put into your EX area, and bury the rest.

Activated ability cost is incomplete. The source requires '[engage], discard a card'; encode the discard as part of the activated cost instead of as an optionalCost effect so the damage effect is mandatory after paying the cost.
